title: Tangling Hairbrush
normalExpectation: Brushing untangles hair and smooths it.
response: Each brush stroke creates a new knot, and the knots tighten the more you brush; hair eventually coils around the brush like a topiary.
whyThisObject: Brush bristles are meant to separate strands; if they weave strands together, brushing becomes tangling.
trigger: Opa brushes once, hair stands up in a giant knot.
goalInterference: The action of brushing makes hair worse, so smooth hair is impossible.
frameZero: Opa stands in front of mirror holding a brush, but his hair is a twisted bird's nest with the brush embedded in it.

sourceBeats.strategy: Opa pulls the brush out slowly, hoping to unwind the knot.
sourceBeats.visibleConsequence: The knot tightens into a bun that pulls his head back.
sourceBeats.newInformation: Pulling the brush out causes the hair to cinch, not loosen.

sourceBeats.strategy: Opa uses a wide-tooth comb to gently work through the tangle.
sourceBeats.visibleConsequence: The comb adds more knots, and his hair expands into a giant sphere around his head.
sourceBeats.newInformation: Any grooming tool multiplies knots instead of removing them.

sourceBeats.strategy: Opa applies hair conditioner to make strands slippery.
sourceBeats.visibleConsequence: The hair becomes like rubber, and the brush bounces off, but the knots stretch and snap back with more loops.
sourceBeats.newInformation: Conditioner turns hair elastic, making tangles spring-loaded.

sourceBeats.strategy: Opa puts on a hat to hide the hair and stop brushing.
sourceBeats.visibleConsequence: The hat is sucked into the hair-knot and swallowed, disappearing into the tangled mass.
sourceBeats.newInformation: The hair's tangling now acts like a living trap, consuming objects.

sourceBeats.strategy: Opa uses scissors to cut the hair away.
sourceBeats.visibleConsequence: The hair regrows instantly into a larger, tighter knot, trapping the scissors.
sourceBeats.newInformation: Cutting triggers accelerated regrowth with more tangles.
